signal: HSI launched Sky, an AI assistant, earned SHRM accreditation, and announced a strategic partnership with Enhesa to expand its regulatory compliance offerings in early 2026

email.body1:
Andrea, saw HSI launched Sky, picked up SHRM accreditation, and partnered with Enhesa to widen the compliance catalog.

A broader product set usually opens more in-market accounts than the team can work, and reps end up doing research and CRM admin instead of selling. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a signal play for HSI off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Andrea, quick follow-up for HSI.

With the catalog expanding into new compliance areas, most teams do not actually know how many meetings they need to book to cover the new addressable market. The gap shows up late, and by then the quarter is a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings HSI needs this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Andrea, last bit of proof for HSI.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how HSI's reply rate likely compares to other compliance and training vendors. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Andrea, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. New product launches keep a sales team plenty busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your motion? I will tailor it to HSI either way.
